description: Refine components/booking/PatientDetailsView.tsx formal intake forms with uppercase section headers, emerald info callout, border-b-2 form divider, uppercase tracking-widest field labels, border-2 input styling with emerald-600 focus rings, and uppercase tracking-wide button typography across all three conditional sub-forms
steps: 1. Update main section header: 'Step 3: Patient Details' (uppercase, tracking-widest, text-xs, slate-400) + h2 'Provide Your Information' (text-xl, font-bold, slate-900, mt-1). Category badge row: 'Intake Form for:' (slate-600, text-sm) + emerald-700 bg white text uppercase text-xs font-bold px-3 py-1.5 rounded-sm badge showing categoryLabel.

2. Update info callout: border-l-4 border-emerald-600 bg-emerald-50 p-4 mb-6 text-sm emerald-800: 'Please provide accurate details. This information will be used for your clinical intake and queue assignment.'

3. Update form divider header: border-b-2 border-slate-200 pb-3 mb-6: 'PATIENT INTAKE FORM' (uppercase, tracking-widest, text-xs, slate-500, font-bold) + 'Fields marked with (*) are required' (text-xs, slate-400, mt-0.5).

4. Update shared input/label styling in all three sub-forms (NewCheckupForm, FollowUpForm, PhilHealthYakapForm): Labels - uppercase tracking-widest text-xs slate-500 font-semibold mb-1.5. Inputs/textareas/selects - border-2 border-slate-300 focus:border-emerald-600 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-600/20 rounded-sm px-4 py-3 text-sm font-medium slate-900 bg-white. Required marker (*) - red-600 font-bold. Textarea char counter - slate-400 text-xs text-right mt-1. Keep all existing form fields, validation logic, and conditional rendering unchanged.

5. Update FormFooter component: border-t-2 border-slate-200 pt-6 mt-8. Back button: slate-300 border-2 hover:bg-slate-50. Next button: emerald-700 hover:emerald-800 uppercase font-bold py-3 px-6 disabled:slate-300.
